mapper.select: /* AuthSchoolMapMapper.findActiveByUserNo */ SELECT a.id, a.user_no, a.school_code, s.school_name, a.granted_by, a.status, a.created_by, a.updated_by, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM auth_school_map a LEFT JOIN school_info s ON a.school_code = s.school_code WHERE a.user_no = #{userNo} AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY a.school_code ASC
mapper.update: /* AuthSchoolMapMapper.revokeAllByUserNo */ UPDATE auth_school_map SET status = 'REVOKED', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
